Street Rod 2 SE v1.0.0 - bundled components

Street Rod 2 SE.exe
  Port and SE code: MIT, see ../LICENSE.
  https://github.com/SledgeHV/street-rod-2-se
  Based on https://github.com/kylofon/street-rod-2-sdl3

Nuked-OPL3 (linked into Street Rod 2 SE.exe)
  Copyright (C) 2013-2020 Nuke.YKT. GNU LGPL 2.1 or later.
  See Nuked-OPL3-LICENSE.txt.
  https://github.com/nukeykt/Nuked-OPL3
  Version: commit 765ec962e473aeb767e4cba74ffdc8f588ffbfe8 (unmodified).
  Full matching port/application and library source plus build scripts:
  https://github.com/SledgeHV/street-rod-2-se/releases/tag/v1.0.0
  Download street-rod-2-se-v1.0.0-source.zip. The library source is under
  sr2port/third_party/nuked-opl3. Rebuild with build-enhanced.ps1 or CMake
  as documented in README.md; you can modify and relink the library.

SDL3.dll
  SDL 3.4.20, official x86_64-w64-mingw32 development package.
  Copyright (C) 1997-2026 Sam Lantinga and contributors.
  zlib license, see SDL3-LICENSE.txt.
  https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/releases/tag/release-3.4.20
  Unmodified DLL; you may replace it with a compatible build.

No other non-system DLLs are required by this package.
Original Street Rod 2 game data is not included.
